description: This Java class defines an Android Fragment (ContactDetailFragment) that displays detailed information about a contact, including photo, name, and mailing addresses. It handles loading contact data asynchronously, building address views, and user interactions such as editing contact details and viewing addresses on a map.

classes.name: ContactDetailFragment
classes.description: An Android Fragment that displays detailed contact information, including photo, name, and addresses, with support for editing and viewing addresses on maps.

methods.name: newInstance
methods.description: Factory method to create a new instance of ContactDetailFragment with a specified contact Uri.

methods.name: setContact
methods.description: Sets or clears the contact to be displayed, updating UI and starting data queries accordingly.

methods.name: onCreate
methods.description: Initializes fragment, including layout and image loader setup.

methods.name: onCreateView
methods.description: Inflates the fragment layout and initializes view references.

methods.name: onActivityCreated
methods.description: Restores or initializes contact data after activity creation.

methods.name: onSaveInstanceState
methods.description: Saves current contact Uri for state restoration.

methods.name: onOptionsItemSelected
methods.description: Handles menu actions, such as editing contact.

methods.name: onCreateOptionsMenu
methods.description: Inflates menu and manages menu item visibility.

methods.name: onCreateLoader
methods.description: Creates loaders for contact details and addresses queries.

methods.name: onLoadFinished
methods.description: Processes loaded contact data and updates UI accordingly.

methods.name: buildEmptyAddressLayout
methods.description: Creates a layout indicating no addresses are available.

methods.name: buildAddressLayout
methods.description: Builds a layout for a specific address with view button to open map.

methods.name: constructGeoUri
methods.description: Constructs a geo URI for map viewing from an address.

methods.name: getLargestScreenDimension
methods.description: Returns the larger of screen width or height in pixels.

methods.name: loadContactPhoto
methods.description: Loads and decodes contact photo thumbnail asynchronously.
